title: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback as Thermodynamic Entropy Minimisation: A Formal Isomorphism and Testable Predictions
abstract: RLHF is formally isomorphic to statistical-mechanical free energy minimisation. The mapping is algebraically exact: reward maps to negative energy, the KL penalty coefficient maps to temperature, and the RLHF objective equals negative Helmholtz free energy. Three falsifiable predictions follow: optimal temperature scaling as H_task^{-1/2}, grokking latent period proportional to entropy gap over effective temperature, and a universal alignment-capability bound from free-energy constraints.
